newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold closes easier after trading in range.
newsitem.headline: HK gold closes easier after trading in range.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed easier on Wednesday after a day of narrow range trading, dealers said.
"It's been very quiet all day with nothing special happening in the local market. The price of gold stayed in a 30 U.S. cent range," a local trading house dealer said.
Bullion ended at US$343.10/60 an ounce against New York's US$343.70/344.20 close on Tuesday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$343.90/344.40.
"Sentiment on gold is mixed and its next move is solely dictated by the other precious metals and the U.S. dollar," another bullion dealer said.
Local gold ended HK$7 lower at HK$3,176 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to nil from its previous fix at +4.00.
Hong Kong midday - US$343.10/60 Hong Kong open - US$343.30/80
